items.title: Prediction: Robinhood Will Pass $500 Billion in Customer Assets in 2027
items.summary: Customers keep moving billions onto the platform every month. Reaching the milestone needs less help from the market than you might think.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Nasdaq, S&P 500 Hold; Robinhood, Sandisk, AMD, Moderna Surge Into Buy Areas
items.summary: The stock market showed choppy, mixed weekly action. But Robinhood, Sandisk, AMD and Moderna rallied into buy areas.

items.title: Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan Adjusts His Crypto Outlook After the Senate Vote. Here’s What He Changed
items.summary: Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan reversed a months-long warning about the CLARITY Act within 24 hours of its Senate defeat, and the market celebrated his pivot. But three quiet caveats buried in his memo tell a different story about what he actually believes.

items.title: Robinhood and Coinbase Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after the SEC announced a five-year conditional Innovation Exemption allowing eligible platforms to trade tokenized U.S. equities without standard exchange registration.

items.title: Robinhood CFO Shiv Verma Sells 11,472 Shares for $1.3 Million
items.summary: The disposal was executed under a pre-established Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted in August 2025, reducing the insider's direct stake to 56,858 shares.

items.title: COIN Stock Trades at a Premium to Industry: What Should Investors Do?
items.summary: Coinbase trades at a steep premium as diversification, global expansion and recurring revenues support growth as crypto volatility and earnings pressures loom.

items.title: Bitcoin Is Rallying and Coinbase Is Today’s Best Stock in the S&P 500 Against All the Odds
items.summary: The collapse of the Clarity Act and a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike ought to have been a toxic combination for  Bitcoin  but the world’s largest cryptocurrency was showing its resilience on Friday.  The token has risen 5.7% to $80,884 over the past 24 hours, according to CoinDesk.  Shares of Bitcoin investor  Strategy  rose 15% on Friday.

items.title: Is Solana the Biggest Winner From the SEC’s Tokenized Stock Rule? $465 Million of Stocks Already Trade There
items.summary: The SEC just opened a legal lane for tokenized stocks, and Solana already holds nearly half the market. But a closer look at the fine print reveals why its head start may count for less than it appears.
